description: Dump evenly spaced PNG frames from the final video (or the raw take) into output/frames/ for review — look at them instead of hand-running `ffmpeg -ss`. Needs only the video (no key). Returns a jobId immediately — poll job_status. Rejects if another job is running.

dir.description: demo project directory — pass an absolute path

source.description: final = output/final-demo.mp4 (default); raw = the latest raw file; take = the whole recorded take, across the raw files a resumed take is spliced from

width.description: frame width in px, aspect kept (default 640)

name: frames
